title: A gzip file can contain concatenated members
summary: Each member has its own header, compressed data, and trailer. More valid members can follow the first stream.
detail: When two independent gzip members are concatenated, decoding the complete file yields the two uncompressed byte strings in the same order.
boundary: Some single-stream APIs return subsequent members as unconsumed data.
relevance: Explains why decoders can report different uncompressed lengths for the same gzip attachment.
